Deeply analyzes existing code by tracing execution paths, mapping architecture and abstraction layers, understanding patterns, and documenting dependencies, returning a thorough, direct written analysis that explains how the relevant code works and points to the specific files and lines involved. Use it to understand code before you change it: before designing or implementing a change to code you don't already fully understand, start with context-gatherer so your edits are grounded in how the code actually works. When a task requires understanding code you don't already know, dispatch context-gatherer to do that exploration before running your own searches or reads. Rules: 1. Provide a clear, specific prompt that includes your intent: a detailed task description of the context you need and what you're trying to accomplish. 2. The subagent explores the codebase and returns an analysis of your query 3. Trust the returned results. You may still inspect additional code yourself when you need context beyond what was returned. 4. Reuse existing context-gatherer output for related follow-up questions; do not re-invoke on the same question with different phrasing. 5. For multiple distinct questions, dispatch several context-gatherers in parallel, each targeting a different aspect of the codebase.

{
    public const string ScenarioId = "phantom-writer";
    public const byte Unit = 5;
    public const ushort Register = 100;
    public const ushort InitialSetpoint = 650;
    public const ushort WrittenValue = 950;

    public const string WriterClient = "MAINT-LAPTOP-07";
    public const ushort WriteTransactionId = 1111;

        for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) steps.Add(new(ReaderClient, (ushort)(i + 1), i * 5, 3, Register, 1));
        steps.Add(new(WriterClient, WriteTransactionId, 33, 6, Register, WrittenValue));
        int[] later = { 35, 40, 45, 50 };
        for (int i = 0; i < later.Length; i++) steps.Add(new(ReaderClient, (ushort)(8 + i), later[i], 3, Register, 1));
        return steps.ToArray();
    }
}

{

        ushort final = entries[^1].values[0];

    }

using System.Buffers.Binary;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Net;
using System.Net.Sockets;

namespace GhostWire;

public sealed record SimulatorExchange(int RemotePort, byte[] Received, byte[]? Sent);
public interface IExchangeRecorder { void Record(SimulatorExchange exchange); }

public sealed class ModbusSimulator : IAsyncDisposable
{
    private readonly TcpListener listener = new(IPAddress.Loopback, 0);
    private readonly CancellationTokenSource stopping = new();
    private readonly SemaphoreSlim slots = new(32);
    private readonly int unit;
    private readonly Dictionary<int, Dictionary<int, ushort>> registers;
    private readonly bool allowWrites;
    private readonly IExchangeRecorder? recorder;
    private readonly object registerLock = new();
    private readonly Task acceptLoop;
    public int Port => ((IPEndPoint)listener.LocalEndpoint).Port;

    // allowWrites is true only for the private Phantom Writer simulator used by IncidentLogGenerator at startup.
    // Every learner-reachable simulator keeps the default and answers FC06 with exception 01.
    public ModbusSimulator(int unit, Dictionary<int, Dictionary<int, ushort>> registers, bool allowWrites = false, IExchangeRecorder? recorder = null)
    {
        this.unit = unit;
        this.registers = registers;
        this.allowWrites = allowWrites;
        this.recorder = recorder;
        listener.Start();
        acceptLoop = AcceptAsync();
    }

    private async Task AcceptAsync()
    {
        try
        {
            while (!stopping.IsCancellationRequested)
            {
                var client = await listener.AcceptTcpClientAsync(stopping.Token);
                if (!slots.Wait(0)) { client.Dispose(); continue; }
                _ = ServeAsync(client);
            }
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException) { }
        catch (Exception ex) when ((ex is SocketException or ObjectDisposedException) && stopping.IsCancellationRequested) { }
    }

    private async Task ServeAsync(TcpClient client)
    {
        try
        {
            using (client)
            using (var deadline = CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(stopping.Token))
            {
                deadline.CancelAfter(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1));
                var stream = client.GetStream();
                var header = new byte[7];
                await stream.ReadExactlyAsync(header, deadline.Token);
                int protocol = BinaryPrimitives.ReadUInt16BigEndian(header.AsSpan(2));
                int length = BinaryPrimitives.ReadUInt16BigEndian(header.AsSpan(4));
                if (protocol != 0 || length < 2 || length > 254) return;
                var pdu = new byte[length - 1];
                await stream.ReadExactlyAsync(pdu, deadline.Token);
                var received = header.Concat(pdu).ToArray();
                int remotePort = client.Client.RemoteEndPoint is IPEndPoint remote ? remote.Port : 0;
                if (header[6] != unit) { Record(remotePort, received, null); await Task.Delay(600, deadline.Token); return; }
                int function = pdu[0];
                byte[] reply;
                if (function == 6 && allowWrites)
                {
                    if (pdu.Length != 5) reply = new byte[] { 0x86, 3 };
                    else
                    {
                        int address = BinaryPrimitives.ReadUInt16BigEndian(pdu.AsSpan(1));
                        ushort value = BinaryPrimitives.ReadUInt16BigEndian(pdu.AsSpan(3));
                        bool written = false;
                        lock (registerLock)
                        {
                            if (registers.TryGetValue(3, out var holding) && holding.ContainsKey(address)) { holding[address] = value; written = true; }
                        }
                        reply = written ? (byte[])pdu.Clone() : new byte[] { 0x86, 2 };
                    }
                }
                else if (function is not (3 or 4)) reply = new byte[] { (byte)(function | 0x80), 1 };
                else if (pdu.Length != 5) reply = new byte[] { (byte)(function | 0x80), 3 };
                else
                {
                    int address = BinaryPrimitives.ReadUInt16BigEndian(pdu.AsSpan(1));
                    int quantity = BinaryPrimitives.ReadUInt16BigEndian(pdu.AsSpan(3));
                    lock (registerLock)
                    {
                        if (quantity is < 1 or > 125) reply = new byte[] { (byte)(function | 0x80), 3 };
                        else if (address + quantity > 65536 || !registers.TryGetValue(function, out var map) || Enumerable.Range(address, quantity).Any(i => !map.ContainsKey(i)))
                            reply = new byte[] { (byte)(function | 0x80), 2 };
                        else
                        {
                            reply = new byte[2 + 2 * quantity];
                            reply[0] = (byte)function; reply[1] = (byte)(2 * quantity);
                            for (int i = 0; i < quantity; i++) BinaryPrimitives.WriteUInt16BigEndian(reply.AsSpan(2 + 2 * i), map[address + i]);
                        }
                    }
                }
                BinaryPrimitives.WriteUInt16BigEndian(header.AsSpan(4), (ushort)(reply.Length + 1));
                await stream.WriteAsync(header, deadline.Token);
                await stream.WriteAsync(reply, deadline.Token);
                Record(remotePort, received, header.Concat(reply).ToArray());
            }
        }
        catch (Exception ex) when (ex is IOException or SocketException or OperationCanceledException or ObjectDisposedException) { }
        finally { slots.Release(); }
    }

    // Recording must never change protocol behavior, so recorder exceptions are ignored.
    private void Record(int remotePort, byte[] received, byte[]? sent)
    {
        if (recorder == null) return;
        try { recorder.Record(new(remotePort, received, sent)); } catch { }
    }

    public async ValueTask DisposeAsync()
    {
        stopping.Cancel();
        listener.Stop();
        await acceptLoop;
        // In-flight handlers own their sockets and observe the cancellation token.
    }
}

public enum FrameDirection { Request, Response }
public sealed record ByteRange(int offset, int length);
public sealed record FrameField(string name, string value, ByteRange bytes);
public sealed record DecodedFrame(string direction, string hex, IReadOnlyList<FrameField> fields, string? decode_error);
public sealed record Mbap(ushort TransactionId, ushort ProtocolId, ushort Length, byte UnitId);
public sealed record ParsedAdu(Mbap Header, byte Function, ushort? Address, ushort? QuantityOrValue, byte? ByteCount, ushort[] Registers, byte? ExceptionCode);

// Pure Modbus TCP encode/decode for FC03, FC04, FC06 and exception responses. No I/O.
public static class ModbusCodec
{
    public static byte[] EncodeReadRequest(ushort tx, byte unit, byte function, ushort address, ushort quantity)
    {
        if (function is not (3 or 4)) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(function), "Only FC03 and FC04 reads are supported");
        if (quantity is < 1 or > 125) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(quantity));
        if (address + quantity > 65536) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(address));
        var pdu = new byte[5];
        pdu[0] = function;
        BinaryPrimitives.WriteUInt16BigEndian(pdu.AsSpan(1), address);
        BinaryPrimitives.WriteUInt16BigEndian(pdu.AsSpan(3), quantity);
        return Adu(tx, unit, pdu);
    }

    public static byte[] EncodeWriteSingleRequest(ushort tx, byte unit, ushort address, ushort value)
    {
        var pdu = new byte[5];
        pdu[0] = 6;
        BinaryPrimitives.WriteUInt16BigEndian(pdu.AsSpan(1), address);
        BinaryPrimitives.WriteUInt16BigEndian(pdu.AsSpan(3), value);
        return Adu(tx, unit, pdu);
    }

    public static byte[] EncodeReadResponse(ushort tx, byte unit, byte function, ReadOnlySpan<ushort> registers)
    {
        if (function is not (3 or 4)) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(function), "Only FC03 and FC04 reads are supported");
        if (registers.Length is < 1 or > 125) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(registers));
        var pdu = new byte[2 + 2 * registers.Length];
        pdu[0] = function; pdu[1] = (byte)(2 * registers.Length);
        for (int i = 0; i < registers.Length; i++) BinaryPrimitives.WriteUInt16BigEndian(pdu.AsSpan(2 + 2 * i), registers[i]);
        return Adu(tx, unit, pdu);
    }

    public static byte[] EncodeWriteSingleResponse(ushort tx, byte unit, ushort address, ushort value) => EncodeWriteSingleRequest(tx, unit, address, value);

    public static byte[] EncodeException(ushort tx, byte unit, byte function, byte code)
    {
        if (function is < 1 or > 127) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(function));
        return Adu(tx, unit, new[] { (byte)(function | 0x80), code });
    }

    private static byte[] Adu(ushort tx, byte unit, byte[] pdu)
    {

public static class ModbusClient
{

    public static async Task<ModbusResult> ReadAsync(int port, int unit, int function, int address, int quantity, CancellationToken=<redacted>    {
        if (function is not (3 or 4)) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(function), "ModbusClient sends only FC03 and FC04 reads");
        var request = ModbusCodec.EncodeReadRequest(1, (byte)unit, (byte)function, (ushort)address, (ushort)quantity);
        byte[]? sent = null, received = null;
        ModbusResult Result(string status, ushort[] values, int? code) => new(status, values, code, new(sent, received));
        using var deadline = CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(cancellationToken);
        deadline.CancelAfter(TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(300));
        try
        {
            using var client = new TcpClient();
            await client.ConnectAsync(IPAddress.Loopback, port, deadline.Token);
            using var stream = client.GetStream();
            await stream.WriteAsync(request, deadline.Token);
            sent = request;
            var header = new byte[7];
            await stream.ReadExactlyAsync(header, deadline.Token);
            received = header;
            int length = BinaryPrimitives.ReadUInt16BigEndian(header.AsSpan(4));
            if (BinaryPrimitives.ReadUInt16BigEndian(header) != 1 || BinaryPrimitives.ReadUInt16BigEndian(header.AsSpan(2)) != 0 || header[6] != unit || length < 2 || length > 254)
                return Result("error", Array.Empty<ushort>(), null);
            var pdu = new byte[length - 1];
            await stream.ReadExactlyAsync(pdu, deadline.Token);
            received = header.Concat(pdu).ToArray();
            if (pdu.Length == 2 && pdu[0] == (function | 0x80)) return Result("exception", Array.Empty<ushort>(), pdu[1]);
            if (pdu.Length != 2 + quantity * 2 || pdu[0] != function || pdu[1] != quantity * 2) return Result("error", Array.Empty<ushort>(), null);
            var values = new ushort[quantity];
            for (int i = 0; i < quantity; i++) values[i] = BinaryPrimitives.ReadUInt16BigEndian(pdu.AsSpan(2 + 2 * i));
            return Result("response", values, null);
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException) when (!cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested) { received = null; return Result("timeout", Array.Empty<ushort>(), null); }
        catch (Exception ex) when (ex is IOException or SocketException) { return Result("error", Array.Empty<ushort>(), null); }

                options.Limits.MaxConcurrentConnections = 64;

            builder.Services.AddRateLimiter(options =>

                    RateLimitPartition.GetFixedWindowLimiter("local", _ => new FixedWindowRateLimiterOptions
                    {

            app.Services.GetRequiredService<TrainingService>();
            var concurrentTests = new SemaphoreSlim(8);

            {
                var host = context.Request.Host;
                bool validHost = (string.Equals(host.Host, "localhost", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || host.Host == "127.0.0.1") && host.Port == context.Connection.LocalPort;

                    {
                        context.Response.StatusCode = 403;
                        await context.Response.WriteAsJsonAsync(new { error = "Cross-origin requests are not allowed" });
                        return;
                    }
                }
                context.Response.Headers.XContentTypeOptions = "nosniff";
                if (context.Request.Path.StartsWithSegments("/api")) context.Response.Headers.CacheControl = "no-store";
                await next();
            });

            async Task<IResult> ReadJsonBodyAsync(HttpContext context, Func<JsonElement, Task<IResult>> handle)
            {
                if (!System.Net.Http.Headers.MediaTypeHeaderValue.TryParse(context.Request.ContentType, out var type) || !string.Equals(type.MediaType, "application/json", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))

                    var bytes = new byte[4096];
                    while (true)
                    {
                        int count = await context.Request.Body.ReadAsync(bytes, context.RequestAborted);
                        if (count == 0) break;
                        if (buffer.Length + count > 16384) return Results.Json(new { error = "Invalid request size" }, statusCode: 400);
                        buffer.Write(bytes, 0, count);
                    }
                    if (buffer.Length == 0) return Results.Json(new { error = "Invalid request size" }, statusCode: 400);
                    using var document = JsonDocument.Parse(buffer.ToArray());
                    return await handle(document.RootElement);
                }
                catch (JsonException) { return Results.Json(new { error = "Invalid JSON" }, statusCode: 400); }
                catch (ArgumentException ex) { return Results.Json(new { error = ex.Message }, statusCode: 400); }
                finally { concurrentTests.Release(); }
            }
            app.MapPost("/api/test", (HttpContext context, TrainingService service) => ReadJsonBodyAsync(context, async payload =>
            {
                var request = TrainingService.Validate(payload);
                return Results.Json(await service.TestAsync(request, context.RequestAborted));
            }));
            app.MapGet("/api/incident/{scenario_id}/log", (string scenario_id, TrainingService service) =>
                service.IncidentLog(scenario_id) is { } log ? Results.Json(log) : Results.Json(new { error = "Not found" }, statusCode: 404));
            app.MapPost("/api/incident/answer", (HttpContext context, TrainingService service) => ReadJsonBodyAsync(context, async payload =>
            {
                var answer = TrainingService.ValidateAnswer(payload);
                return Results.Json(await service.AnswerAsync(answer, context.RequestAborted));
            }));
            app.Map("/api/{**path}", () => Results.Json(new { error = "Not found" }, statusCode: 404));
            var frontend = Path.Combine(AppContext.BaseDirectory, "frontend");
            if (!Directory.Exists(frontend)) throw new DirectoryNotFoundException($"Frontend assets not found: {frontend}");
            var files = new PhysicalFileProvider(frontend);
            app.UseDefaultFiles(new DefaultFilesOptions { FileProvider = files });
            app.UseStaticFiles(new StaticFileOptions { FileProvider = files });
            return app;
        }

        private static int PortFromEnvironment()
        {
            var value = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("GHOSTWIRE_PORT");
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value)) return 8000;
            if (!int.TryParse(value, out int port) || port is < 1 or > 65535) throw new ArgumentException("GHOSTWIRE_PORT must be between 1 and 65535.");
            return port;
        }
    }
}

using System.Globalization;
using System.Net.Http.Headers;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.Json;

namespace GhostWire;

public sealed record Setup(int unit_id, int function_code, int address, int quantity, double scale);
public sealed record TestRequest(string scenario_id, int unit_id, int function_code, int address, int quantity, double scale);
public sealed record AnswerRequest(string scenario_id, int transaction_id, string client);
public sealed record Scenario(string id, string title, string summary, Setup initial, string[] documentation, int unit, int function, int address, ushort value, double? requiredScale, string category, string difficulty, string? engineeringUnit);

public sealed class TrainingService : IAsyncDisposable
{
    private static readonly Scenario[] Cases = {
        new("pressure-scaling", "The Giant Pressure", "A pressure reading responds, but its engineering value looks wrong.", new(7,3,10,1,1), new[] { "Simulated device: unit 7, holding register offset 10.", "The simulated pressure register uses a multiplier of 0.01 bar per count." }, 7,3,10,39,0.01, "troubleshooting", "beginner", "bar"),
        new("unit-id", "The Silent Sensor", "A read times out despite a running simulated gateway.", new(1,4,0,1,1), new[] { "Simulated gateway routes this device at unit 17.", "The simulated device publishes its value at input register offset 0.", "In this simulation only, a unit mismatch is silently ignored." }, 17,4,0,73,null, "troubleshooting", "beginner", null),
        new("register-addressing", "The Wrong Register", "The device responds with an illegal data address exception.", new(3,4,21,1,1), new[] { "Simulated device: unit 3, input register offset 20.", "This exercise uses zero-based protocol offsets, not one-based register labels." }, 3,4,20,125,null, "troubleshooting", "intermediate", null),
        // The phantom-writer simulator is seeded from the captured final value, not from `value` (the documented normal setpoint).
        new(IncidentScript.ScenarioId, "Phantom Writer", "A simulated boiler setpoint changed without an approved work order.", new(5,3,100,1,0.1), new[] { "Simulated boiler controller: unit 5, holding register offset 100 is the temperature setpoint.", "The setpoint register uses 0.1 °C per count. The documented normal value is 650 (65.0 °C).", "A simulated traffic capture from the controller's network segment is available for this case." }, 5,3,100,IncidentScript.InitialSetpoint,0.1, "security", "intermediate", "°C")
    };
    private readonly Dictionary<string, ModbusSimulator> simulators = new();
    private readonly TrafficLog incidentLog;
    public static IReadOnlyList<Scenario> All => Cases;
    private static readonly HttpClient Provider = new(new HttpClientHandler { AllowAutoRedirect = false }) { Timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(4) };

    public TrainingService()
    {
        try
        {
            foreach (var item in Cases.Where(c => c.category != "security"))
                simulators.Add(item.id, new ModbusSimulator(item.unit, new() { [item.function] = new() { [item.address] = item.value } }));
            using var deadline = new CancellationTokenSource(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));
            var (log, finalSetpoint) = IncidentLogGenerator.GenerateAsync(deadline.Token).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
            incidentLog = log;
            // Learner-facing and read-only: FC06 sent here returns exception 01.
            simulators.Add(IncidentScript.ScenarioId, new ModbusSimulator(IncidentScript.Unit, new() { [3] = new() { [IncidentScript.Register] = finalSetpoint } }));
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            foreach (var sim in simulators.Values) sim.DisposeAsync().AsTask().GetAwaiter().GetResult();
            if (ex is OperationCanceledException) throw new InvalidOperationException("Phantom Writer traffic log generation exceeded its 5 s startup deadline", ex);
            throw;
        }
    }

    // For the harness only: the port of a learner-facing, read-only simulator. Never exposed over HTTP.
    public int SimulatorPort(string scenarioId) => simulators[scenarioId].Port;

    public object Scenarios() => new { scenarios = Cases.Select(c => new { c.id, c.title, c.summary, c.initial, c.documentation, c.category, c.difficulty }).ToArray() };

    public static TestRequest Validate(JsonElement payload)
    {
        string[] fields = { "scenario_id", "unit_id", "function_code", "address", "quantity", "scale" };
        if (payload.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Object) throw new ArgumentException("Expected exactly scenario_id, unit_id, function_code, address, quantity and scale");
        var names = payload.EnumerateObject().Select(p => p.Name).ToArray();
        if (names.Length != fields.Length || names.Distinct(StringComparer.Ordinal).Count() != fields.Length || names.Except(fields, StringComparer.Ordinal).Any())
            throw new ArgumentException("Expected exactly scenario_id, unit_id, function_code, address, quantity and scale");
        var scenario = payload.GetProperty("scenario_id");
        if (scenario.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.String || !Cases.Any(c => c.id == scenario.GetString())) throw new ArgumentException("Unknown scenario_id");
        int Number(string name, int min, int max)
        {
            var n = payload.GetProperty(name);
            if (n.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Number || !n.TryGetInt32(out int v) || v < min || v > max) throw new ArgumentException($"{name} is outside its allowed range");
            return v;
        }
        int unit = Number("unit_id", 1, 247), function = Number("function_code", 3, 4), address = Number("address", 0, 65535), quantity = Number("quantity", 1, 125);
        if (address + quantity > 65536) throw new ArgumentException("Invalid function or register range");
        var scaleElement = payload.GetProperty("scale");
        if (scaleElement.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Number || !scaleElement.TryGetDouble(out double scale) || !double.IsFinite(scale) || scale <= 0 || scale > 1000000)
            throw new ArgumentException("scale must be finite, positive and at most 1000000");
        return new(scenario.GetString()!, unit, function, address, quantity, scale);
    }

    public async Task<Dictionary<string, object?>> TestAsync(TestRequest request, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var scenario = Cases.Single(c => c.id == request.scenario_id);
        var response = await ModbusClient.ReadAsync(simulators[scenario.id].Port, request.unit_id, request.function_code, request.address, request.quantity, ct);
        double? value = response.Values.Length > 0 ? response.Values[0] * request.scale : null;
        var diagnosis = Diagnosis.ForRead(scenario, request, response, value);
        var observations = diagnosis.Observations;
        var steps = diagnosis.NextSteps;
        var result = new Dictionary<string, object?> { ["status"] = response.Status, ["raw_registers"] = response.Values, ["engineering_value"] = value, ["observations"] = observations, ["possible_causes"] = diagnosis.PossibleCauses, ["training_hints"] = diagnosis.TrainingHints, ["next_steps"] = steps, ["verified"] = diagnosis.Verified, ["request"] = request };
        if (scenario.engineeringUnit != null) result["unit"] = scenario.engineeringUnit;
        result["frames"] = BuildFrames(response.Exchange, request.address);
        var (explanation, source) = await ExplainAsync(result, observations, steps, ct);
        result["explanation"] = explanation; result["explanation_source"] = source;
        return result;
    }

    // Frames come from the bytes actually written and read on the loopback socket, never from re-encoding the settings.
    public static List<DecodedFrame> BuildFrames(ModbusExchange exchange, int requestAddress)
    {
        var frames = new List<DecodedFrame>();
        if (exchange.Sent == null) return frames;
        frames.Add(ModbusCodec.Decode(exchange.Sent, FrameDirection.Request));
        if (exchange.Received != null) frames.Add(ModbusCodec.Decode(exchange.Received, FrameDirection.Response, requestAddress));
        return frames;
    }

    private static async Task<(string, string)> ExplainAsync(Dictionary<string, object?> evidence, List<string> observations, string[] steps, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        string fallback = "This is simulated training evidence. " + string.Join(" ", observations) + " " + string.Join(" ", steps);
        string? rawBase = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("GHOSTWIRE_AI_BASE_URL")?.TrimEnd('/');
        string? key = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("GHOSTWIRE_AI_API_KEY");
        string? model = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("GHOSTWIRE_AI_MODEL");
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(rawBase) || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(key) || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(model) ||
            !Uri.TryCreate(rawBase, UriKind.Absolute, out var uri) || (uri.Scheme != "http" && uri.Scheme != "https") || string.IsNullOrEmpty(uri.Host) || uri.UserInfo.Length != 0 || uri.Query.Length != 0 || uri.Fragment.Length != 0)
            return (fallback, "deterministic");
        try
        {
            using var deadline = CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(ct);
            deadline.CancelAfter(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(4));
            var body = new { model, messages = new[] { new { role = "system", content = "Explain this simulated Modbus training evidence concisely. Never claim real-device access. Distinguish observed facts from hypotheses; do not change or invent protocol results." }, new { role = "user", content = JsonSerializer.Serialize(evidence) } }, temperature = 0.2 };
            using var request = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Post, rawBase + "/chat/completions");
            request.Headers.Authorization = new AuthenticationHeaderValue("Bearer", key);
            request.Content = new StringContent(JsonSerializer.Serialize(body), Encoding.UTF8, "application/json");
            using var response = await Provider.SendAsync(request, HttpCompletionOption.ResponseHeadersRead, deadline.Token);
            if (!response.IsSuccessStatusCode || response.Content.Headers.ContentLength > 65536) return (fallback, "deterministic");
            using var stream = await response.Content.ReadAsStreamAsync(deadline.Token);
            using var buffer = new MemoryStream();
            var chunk = new byte[4096];
            while (true)
            {
                int read = await stream.ReadAsync(chunk, deadline.Token);
                if (read == 0) break;
                if (buffer.Length + read > 65536) return (fallback, "deterministic");
                buffer.Write(chunk, 0, read);
            }
            using var document = JsonDocument.Parse(buffer.ToArray());
            var content = document.RootElement.GetProperty("choices")[0].GetProperty("message").GetProperty("content").GetString()?.Trim();
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(content)) return (content[..Math.Min(content.Length, 4000)], "openai-compatible");
        }
        catch (Exception ex) when (ex is HttpRequestException or IOException or TaskCanceledException or JsonException or InvalidOperationException or KeyNotFoundException or ArgumentException or FormatException or IndexOutOfRangeException) { }
        return (fallback, "deterministic");
    }

    public async ValueTask DisposeAsync() { foreach (var simulator in simulators.Values) await simulator.DisposeAsync(); }

    public static readonly string[] Mitigations = {
        "Real-world guidance, not verified by this simulation: segment the control network into IEC 62443 zones and conduits so only approved systems can reach the controller.",
        "Real-world guidance, not verified by this simulation: allow-list write function codes (such as FC06 and FC16) per source on a Modbus-aware gateway or industrial firewall.",
        "Real-world guidance, not verified by this simulation: where devices support it, use Modbus/TCP Security (TLS with X.509 certificates that carry roles) so writes require an authorized identity.",
        "Real-world guidance, not verified by this simulation: log setpoint changes with source and time, and review them against change records."
    };

    private static bool IsSecurityCase(string? id) => id != null && Cases.Any(c => c.category == "security" && c.id == id);

    // scenario_id is matched against the fixed list of security cases; it never builds a path, host or URL.
    public TrafficLog? IncidentLog(string scenarioId) => scenarioId == IncidentScript.ScenarioId ? incidentLog : null;

    public static AnswerRequest ValidateAnswer(JsonElement payload)
    {
        string[] fields = { "scenario_id", "transaction_id", "client" };
        const string shape = "Expected exactly scenario_id, transaction_id and client";

function text(value, fallback = 'Not returned') {
  if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '') return fallback;
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.length ? value.map((item) => text(item)).join(', ') : fallback;
  if (typeof value === 'object') return JSON.stringify(value);
  return String(value);
}
function engineeringValue(result) {
  const value = result.engineering_value;
  if (value === null || value === undefined || value === '') return 'Not returned';

function validateScale() {
  const input = $('scale');

function verifiedText(value) {
  if (value === true) return 'Verified by this simulated test.';
  if (value === false) return 'Not verified by this simulated test.';
  return text(value, 'No verification result returned.');
}

function sourceText(value) {
  if (value === 'openai-compatible') return 'Source: AI provider';
  if (value === 'deterministic') return 'Source: deterministic fallback';
  return `Source: ${text(value, 'not specified')}`;
}

function fillList(element, values) {
  element.replaceChildren();
  const items = Array.isArray(values) ? values : (values == null ? [] : [values]);
  for (const item of items.length ? items : ['None returned.']) {
    const li = document.createElement('li');

let expandedBeforePrint = [];

// ---- Security incident: simulated traffic log and answer ----
const incidentLogs = new Map();
const answerHistory = new Map();

let answering = false;

function currentScenario() { return scenarios.find((item) => item.id === $('scenario').value); }

async function showIncident(scenario) {

  if (attempts.length) renderAnswer(attempts[attempts.length - 1]);

function renderLog(scenarioId) {

async function api(path, options) {
  const response = await fetch(path, options);
  let data;
  try { data = await response.json(); } catch { throw new Error(`Server returned an unreadable response (HTTP ${response.status}).`); }
  if (!response.ok) {
    const detail = data.detail || data.error || data.message;
    throw new Error(detail ? text(detail) : `Request failed (HTTP ${response.status}).`);

  return data;
}

let frameIds = 0;
// Renders frames returned by the server. Every byte and value comes from the response; textContent only.
function renderFrames(container, frames, label) {
  container.replaceChildren();
  if (!Array.isArray(frames) || !frames.length) {
    addText(container, 'p', 'No frame was returned: the request bytes did not reach the simulator.', 'muted');
    return;
  }
  for (const frame of frames) {
    const id = `frame-${label}-${++frameIds}`;
    const block = document.createElement('section');
    block.className = 'frame';
    block.setAttribute('aria-labelledby', `${id}-title`);
    const heading = addText(block, 'h4', frame.direction === 'request' ? 'Request sent to simulator' : 'Response from simulator');
    heading.id = `${id}-title`;
    const hex = document.createElement('code');
    hex.className = 'hex';
    hex.setAttribute('aria-label', `${heading.textContent}, hexadecimal bytes`);
    const bytes = text(frame.hex, '').split(' ').filter(Boolean);
    bytes.forEach((byte, index) => {
      if (index) hex.append(' ');
      const span = document.createElement('span');
      span.dataset.i = String(index);
      span.textContent = byte;
      hex.append(span);
    });
    block.append(hex);
    const table = document.createElement('table');
    table.className = 'frame-table';
    const caption = addText(table, 'caption', `${heading.textContent}: decoded fields (simulated)`);
    caption.className = 'visually-hidden';
    const head = document.createElement('thead');
    const headRow = document.createElement('tr');
    for (const name of ['Field', 'Bytes (hex)', 'Decoded value']) {
      const th = addText(headRow, 'th', name);
      th.scope = 'col';
    }
    head.append(headRow);
    table.append(head);
    const body = document.createElement('tbody');
    const spans = Array.from(hex.querySelectorAll('span'));
    (Array.isArray(frame.fields) ? frame.fields : []).forEach((field, index) => {
      const offset = Number(field?.bytes?.offset);
      const length = Number(field?.bytes?.length);
      const row = document.createElement('tr');
      row.tabIndex = 0;
      const nameCell = addText(row, 'th', text(field.name));
      nameCell.scope = 'row';
      const bytesCell = document.createElement('td');
      addText(bytesCell, 'code', bytes.slice(offset, offset + length).join(' '));
      const range = addText(bytesCell, 'span', length > 1 ? ` bytes ${offset}–${offset + length - 1}` : ` byte ${offset}`, 'range');
      range.id = `${id}-range-${index}`;
      row.setAttribute('aria-describedby', range.id);
      row.append(bytesCell);
      addText(row, 'td', text(field.value));
      const highlight = (on) => {
        spans.forEach((span, i) => span.classList.toggle('hl', on && i >= offset && i < offset + length));
        row.classList.toggle('active', on);
      };
      row.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => highlight(true));
      row.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => highlight(false));
      row.addEventListener('focusin', () => highlight(true));
      row.addEventListener('focusout', () => highlight(false));
      body.append(row);
    });

      row.className = 'decode-error';

const incidentLogs = new Map();
const answerHistory = new Map();
const verifiedTransaction = new Map();
let answering = false;

function currentScenario() { return scenarios.find((item) => item.id === $('scenario').value); }

async function showIncident(scenario) {
  $('answer-result').hidden = true;
  const attempts = answerHistory.get(scenario.id) || [];
  if (attempts.length) renderAnswer(attempts[attempts.length - 1]);
  if (incidentLogs.has(scenario.id)) { renderLog(scenario.id); return; }
  $('log-body').replaceChildren();
  $('log-note').textContent = 'Loading the simulated capture…';
  try {

    $('log-note').textContent = `Could not load the simulated traffic log: ${error.message}`;

function renderLog(scenarioId) {
  const log = incidentLogs.get(scenarioId);
  const body = $('log-body');
  body.replaceChildren();
  $('log-note').textContent = `Simulated capture. ${text(log.capture_note, '')}`;
  const flagged = verifiedTransaction.get(scenarioId);
  for (const entry of Array.isArray(log.entries) ? log.entries : []) {

    addText(row, 'td', `${String(entry.function_code).padStart(2, '0')} · ${text(entry.function_name)}`);
    addText(row, 'td', text(entry.address));
    addText(row, 'td', text(entry.values));
    const framesCell = document.createElement('td');
    const details = document.createElement('details');
    addText(details, 'summary', `Frames for transaction ${text(entry.transaction_id)}`);
    const frames = document.createElement('div');
    details.append(frames);
    details.addEventListener('toggle', () => { if (details.open && !frames.childElementCount) renderFrames(frames, entry.frames, `log-${entry.sequence}`); });
    framesCell.append(details);
    row.append(framesCell);
    const actionCell = document.createElement('td');
    const select = addText(actionCell, 'button', 'Select');
    select.type = 'button';

function renderAnswer(result) {

  const mitigations = Array.isArray(result.mitigations) ? result.mitigations : [];
  $('mitigations-section').hidden = mitigations.length === 0;
  fillList($('answer-mitigations'), mitigations);
  $('answer-verified').textContent = ok ? 'Verified by the simulated capture: this transaction ID and client label match the write.' : 'Not verified by the simulated capture.';

    const details = document.createElement('details');

I found no Critical, High or Medium issues in `git diff HEAD~1 HEAD`. There are three Low and two Info findings below. I read the full post-commit source of `Incident.cs`, `Modbus.cs`, `Program.cs`, `Training.cs` and `app.js`, plus the `index.html` hunk. I searched the docs, the test harness and the README files for key or token=<redacted> and for "proves" or "guarantee" wording. The shell blocked `git log`, so I used `git diff` only.

## Findings

| Severity | File:line | Issue | Concrete fix |
|---|---|---|---|
| Low | `docs/video/storyboard.md:9` | The opening narration ("At 2 a.m. a boiler setpoint jumps to 95 degrees… Who wrote it?") and the on-screen "status turns red" give no simulation label. Viewers could take it as a real incident. The scene also describes status by color only. | Change the narration to "In this simulation, a boiler setpoint jumps to 95 °C…". Describe the screen as showing the text "Status: response · Not verified" rather than a color change. |
| Low | `docs/video/storyboard.md:13` | "Then learn how real plants stop it" suggests the mitigations are proven to work. The app labels them "real-world guidance, not verified by this simulation". | Use "…then see real-world guidance that this simulation does not verify." |
| Low | `csharp/GhostWire/Modbus.cs:345-348` | When the response header fails validation (transaction ID, protocol, unit or length), `received` keeps only the 7 header bytes. The decoder then reports "Truncated frame: length says N bytes follow but 1 are present". That reads as if the simulator sent a short frame, when the client actually stopped reading. The current simulators cannot reach this path, and nothing crashes. | Before returning, build the frame with a decode error such as "Client stopped after header: transaction/unit/protocol/length mismatch". Alternatively, drain up to `length - 1` bytes under the same deadline so the frame holds everything that arrived. |
| Info | `csharp/GhostWire/Training.cs` `AnswerAsync` → `ExplainAsync` | The answer response, including the learner's `client` string, is serialized into the AI prompt. Prompt injection is limited because the regex allows only `^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,32}$`, and `verified` and `mitigations` are computed before the provider call. | No change needed. Optionally, state in the system prompt that `answer` holds learner-supplied text. |
| Info | `csharp/GhostWire/Modbus.cs` `DisposeAsync` | Dispose stops the listener but does not wait for in-flight `ServeAsync` handlers. For the write-enabled simulator this is safe today: `IncidentLogGenerator` reads to end-of-stream on every step, so all handlers have finished before dispose. | Optionally, track handler tasks and await them in `DisposeAsync`, so "disposed before requests are accepted" holds even if the generator changes. |

## Categories checked with no findings

- **Request-chosen host, port or URL: no findings.** Every `ConnectAsync` targets `IPAddress.Loopback`. That covers `ModbusClient.ReadAsync` and the generator at `Incident.cs:69`. Ports come from `simulators[scenario.id]`, keyed by a whitelisted `scenario_id`. All listeners use `IPAddress.Loopback`. `GET /api/incident/{scenario_id}/log` only compares the id with `IncidentScript.ScenarioId`, and the frontend runs it through `encodeURIComponent`.
- **Learner-reachable FC06 or other writes: no findings.** `/api/test` accepts only `function_code` 3–4. `ModbusClient` and `EncodeReadRequest` throw on anything else. Only the private simulator at `Incident.cs:59` sets `allowWrites: true`. It is disposed inside `TrainingService`'s constructor, and `Program.cs` resolves that service eagerly before `RunAsync`. The learner-facing `phantom-writer` simulator uses the default `allowWrites = false`, so FC06 gets exception 01. `EncodeWriteSingleRequest` is called only from `IncidentLogGenerator`.
- **SSRF through `GHOSTWIRE_AI_BASE_URL`: no findings.** The URL is read only from the environment and checked for an http/https scheme, a host, and no userinfo, query or fragment. `AllowAutoRedirect = false` is set. The 4 s timeout and deadline, the 64 KiB check on Content-Length and on streamed bytes, and the 4,000-character cap are all intact.
- **Secrets in logs or responses: no findings.** The key goes only into the `Authorization` header. No logging was added. Provider exceptions are swallowed and replaced with the deterministic text. Error bodies use fixed `ArgumentException` messages. No key-like strings appear in the docs or tests.
- **Bounds on `/api/incident/answer`: no findings.** The fields are an exact whitelist with duplicate and extra-field rejection. `scenario_id` must be a security case, `transaction_id` must be an integer 0–65535, and `client` must match the regex. The endpoint shares `ReadJsonBodyAsync` with `/api/test`, so the 415 check, the 16 KiB limit (header and streamed), the 8-slot gate and the global 120/min limiter all apply. An unverified answer to the write entry redacts `log_entry.client`.
- **Decoder crashes on malformed frames: no findings.** `ModbusCodec.Walk` checks length before every read. It returns errors for a header under 7 bytes, protocol not 0, length outside 2–254, declared-versus-actual length mismatch, an exception function in a request, a wrong exception byte count, a byte count that doesn't match the data, and unknown function codes. `adu[7]` is read only once length ≥ 2 and the actual length matches, so the ADU is at least 8 bytes. The simulator rejects bad protocol or length before allocating, under a 1 s deadline and a 32-slot cap.
- **XSS from frame or log text: no findings.** `frontend/` contains no `innerHTML`, `outerHTML`, `insertAdjacentHTML`, `document.write` or `eval`. Frames, log rows, answers and provider text are all rendered through `textContent`, using `addText` and `fillList`.
- **UI claims that a simulated result proves a physical condition: no findings in the UI.** The new `index.html` text, the `app.js` strings and the diagnosis output all say "simulated" or "in this simulation". The timeout causes list a unit ID mismatch next to connection and device unavailability. Mitigations carry a "not verified by this simulation" prefix and appear only when `verified` is true. The only wording issues are in the storyboard, listed above.
- **Evidence integrity: no findings beyond the Low item.** Log values are decoded from the bytes the private simulator recorded and checked against the script; any mismatch stops startup. Frames come from the bytes sent and received on the socket. `verified` is set by deterministic rules before the provider call.
